beats.label: S1 · Seldon Exiled
beats.text: Hari Seldon predicts the Empire's fall; Emperor Cleon XII exiles him and prodigy Gaal Dornick to Terminus to build a Foundation that will shorten the coming dark age.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the Foundation project and Gaal's role — every later thread flows from this trial.

beats.label: S1 · Raych's Betrayal
beats.text: En route to Terminus, Seldon's adopted son Raych murders him and jettisons a horrified Gaal in a cryo pod, breaking her from the mission before the colony arrives.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Splits Gaal from the Foundation and creates the two-strand structure that runs the rest of the series.

beats.label: S1 · Salvor vs Phara
beats.text: Thirty years on, Terminus warden Salvor Hardin repels an Anacreon invasion led by Phara Keaen, who seeks revenge for the Empire's neutron bombing of her homeworld.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Salvor as the Foundation's guardian and the Periphery crisis that forces the first alliance.

beats.label: S1 · A Dynasty Rots
beats.text: On Trantor, religious dissent and Brother Dawn's genetic anomalies expose the cloned dynasty's decay; an ancient conspiracy is revealed to have corrupted Cleon I's DNA long ago.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The genetic sabotage means every future Cleon is compromised — the core weakness driving Empire's decline.

beats.label: S1 · Gaal Meets Digital Hari
beats.text: Gaal wakes decades later on an automated ship; a digital Hari reveals his death was staged and the plan needs a hidden Second Foundation and her prescience to lead it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the Second Foundation and Gaal's prescience, both of which the next season is built around.

beats.label: S1 · Foundation Alliance
beats.text: Salvor unites Terminus with Anacreon and Thespis using the salvaged warship Invictus; a second digital Seldon emerges from the Vault, confirming the alliance was always his plan.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the First Crisis and gives the Foundation a secret power base the Empire believes is dead.

beats.label: S1 · Mother and Daughter
beats.text: Demerzel kills Brother Dawn against Day's orders, revealing her loyalty is to the dynasty over any single Cleon; on Synnax, Gaal wakes her long-frozen daughter Salvor.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Demerzel is now the real power on Trantor, and Gaal+Salvor together set up the whole S2 Ignis arc.

cliffhanger.text: The Foundation has survived its first crisis, but Hari's plan needs a Second Foundation that Gaal was meant to lead. Gaal and the daughter she never knew, Salvor, are together on Synnax with the Prime Radiant, while on Trantor a Cleon dynasty already sabotaged from within rules an Empire it can no longer see clearly.
questions: Will Gaal and Salvor find their way to the Second Foundation Hari intended?
Now that Demerzel serves the dynasty over any sitting Emperor, who really rules Trantor?
How long can the Foundation's secret alliance with Anacreon and Thespis stay hidden from the Empire?

characters.name: Gaal Dornick
characters.line: The mathematical prodigy who confirmed psychohistory at Seldon's trial; woke after 34 years to find him dead and herself a fugitive, now on Synnax with the Prime Radiant.

characters.name: Hari Seldon
characters.line: Creator of psychohistory; killed on the voyage, but two digital copies of him survive — one that spoke to Gaal on the Raven, one enshrined in the Vault on Terminus.

characters.name: Salvor Hardin
characters.line: Warden of Terminus who bested Phara and opened the Vault; discovered she is Gaal and Raych's daughter and now leaves to find her mother.
characters.note: Her prescient visions are inherited from her parents.

characters.name: Brother Day (Cleon XIII)
characters.line: The current Emperor; won his fight with the Luminists but has just learned his own bloodline was sabotaged generations ago.

characters.name: Brother Dusk
characters.line: The elder Cleon whose old failures seeded much of this crisis; survives the season but with his authority weakened.

characters.name: Demerzel
characters.line: The Empire's ancient robot chamberlain, bound to the Cleon dynasty above any individual Cleon; killed Brother Dawn against Day's explicit wishes.

beats.label: S2 · Day's Marriage Plot
beats.text: Brother Day (Cleon XVII) survives a Blind Angels assassination attempt and courts Queen Sareth of the Cloud Dominion to end the failing genetic dynasty and produce natural heirs.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the Sareth/Dawn thread, the Cleon succession crisis, and Demerzel's endgame with the dynasty.

beats.label: S2 · The Mule Appears
beats.text: On Synnax, Gaal and Salvor revive Hari's digital ghost; Gaal glimpses 150 years ahead and meets a Mentalic called the Mule — with Salvor dead beside her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First look at the Mule, who is the entire threat of season 3, and the vision Gaal spends the season trying to unwrite.

beats.label: S2 · Riose and Mallow
beats.text: Empire recruits imprisoned General Bel Riose to investigate the silent Foundation; on the frontier, con man Hober Mallow becomes Vault Seldon's off-book agent.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Both men become the season's opposing frontier agents; Mallow's line matters again generations later.

beats.label: S2 · Ignis Trap
beats.text: Hari's organic body is restored on Oona's World; on Ignis, Mentalic leader Tellem Bond captures them and moves to transfer her own psyche into Gaal's body.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ignis becomes the Second Foundation's site and Tellem's threat forces Gaal to confront her prescience.

beats.label: S2 · Dawn's Heir
beats.text: On Trantor, Sareth and Brother Dawn conceive an heir in secret; Sareth uncovers Demerzel's robotic nature, while Cleon I lures Dusk and Rue into a hidden chamber.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The natural-born heir and the exposure of Demerzel drive the Trantor finale and its aftermath.

beats.label: S2 · Terminus Falls
beats.text: Day crashes the Invictus onto Terminus in a singularity; General Riose refuses to burn the allied worlds and helps She-Bends-Light collide the Imperial fleet with itself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Foundation's homeworld is destroyed and the Imperial fleet gutted — the balance of power tips for the next century.

beats.label: S2 · Sleep for the Mule
beats.text: Demerzel kills Dusk, takes the Prime Radiant, and decants new Cleons; Salvor dies stopping Tellem, so Gaal and Hari cryo-sleep to ready the Second Foundation for the Mule.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Directly sets up the 152-year jump: Demerzel alone on Trantor, Gaal asleep, Salvor gone, Mule inbound.

cliffhanger.text: Terminus is destroyed but its people have been pulled inside Hari's Vault. Salvor is dead, Gaal and Hari are asleep, and Demerzel now rules Trantor alone through a fresh set of Cleons and the Prime Radiant. Sareth and Dawn have fled with an unborn heir, and 152 years ahead, a Mentalic called the Mule has just registered Gaal's existence.
questions: Will Gaal and Hari train a Second Foundation strong enough to stop the Mule?
What will Demerzel do with an Empire no living Cleon can check?
What becomes of Sareth, Dawn, and their child outside the dynasty's reach?

characters.name: Gaal Dornick
characters.line: Now Hari's partner in building the Second Foundation on Ignis; enters cryo-sleep to wake annually and train Mentalics for the Mule she has foreseen.

characters.name: Hari Seldon
characters.line: His consciousness restored to an organic body by the enigmatic Kalle; goes into cryo-sleep with Gaal after Tellem is defeated.

characters.name: Salvor Hardin
characters.line: Killed by the Mentalic Josiah in the finale; her death is the proof Gaal needed that the foreseen future can be changed.

characters.name: Demerzel
characters.line: Killed Dusk against her will, decanted new Cleons, and seized the Prime Radiant — she now effectively rules the Empire alone.

characters.name: Queen Sareth
characters.line: Escaped Trantor pregnant with Brother Dawn's child; heir to the Cloud Dominion and now a rival claim to the Empire itself.

characters.name: Brother Dawn
characters.line: The last living Cleon of his cohort; fled Trantor with Sareth to raise their natural-born heir outside the dynasty.

characters.name: Hober Mallow
characters.line: Foundation's rogue agent recruited by Vault Seldon; ejected into space in a cleaning module by Hober, his pod pulled into the Vault carrying the entire population of Terminus.

characters.name: The Mule
characters.line: A powerful Mentalic 152 years in the future who, at season's close, has become aware of Gaal across time.

beats.label: S3 · The Mule Rises
beats.text: 152 years later, the Foundation controls the Outer Reach; a Mentalic warlord called the Mule takes over the independent planet Kalgan through mind control.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frames the jump forward and names the antagonist the season, and the finale reveal, hinge on.

beats.label: S3 · Gaal and Dawn
beats.text: Gaal wakes on Ignis and secretly aligns with Brother Dawn (Cleon XXV), who wants to blockade Kalgan; on Trantor, Brother Day ignores the crisis for hedonism.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The secret Empire-Foundation channel through Dawn is the political spine of the season.

beats.label: S3 · Mallows Flee
beats.text: Foundation captain Han Pritcher tracks the Mule alone; Toran and Bayta Mallow flee the Mule's court with his balladeer, Magnifico Giganticus.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces every figure central to the finale — Pritcher, the Mallows, and Magnifico.

beats.label: S3 · Demerzel's Confession
beats.text: Demerzel confesses that she staged the Star Bridge attack three centuries ago, framing Anacreon and Thespis to keep Hari alive and preserve the Foundation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Recasts the whole series' inciting incident and clarifies Demerzel's true allegiance heading into the finale.

beats.label: S3 · Mule Takes Terminus
beats.text: The Mule destroys Kalgan and the Imperial fleet; Dawn is thrown out of an airlock, and the Mule then storms and captures New Terminus.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Foundation falls, Empire's fleet is gutted, and Dawn is dead — the board is cleared for the endgame.

beats.label: S3 · Novacula Fires
beats.text: Day flees to Mycogen, learns of the ancient robot Daneel, and seizes a robot head; on Trantor, Dusk fires his Novacula, erasing the Council, Cloud Dominion, and Maiden.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The robot head is the object the finale hinges on, and the Novacula wipes out the last balancing powers.

beats.label: S3 · Bayta Revealed
beats.text: Bayta Mallow is the true Mule, briefly held by Magnifico's music. Dusk takes the Prime Radiant, kills Day, becomes Brother Darkness; a robot head signals Kalle on Earth's Moon.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Every question the next season opens on lives here: the real Mule's identity, Dusk sole ruler, robots on the Moon.

cliffhanger.text: The Mule is not the man Gaal killed — she is Bayta Mallow, still alive and still hunting Gaal. Trantor now belongs to Dusk alone, ruling as Brother Darkness with the Prime Radiant. And a robot head recovered on Mycogen has just sent a clasping signal to Kalle, hidden with other robots on Earth's Moon.
questions: Now that the real Mule is Bayta, how does Gaal stop a Mentalic who has already outmatched her?
What will Dusk do as sole ruler of Empire with psychohistory in his hands?
Who are the robots hiding on Earth's Moon, and what does their signal to Kalle mean?

characters.name: Gaal Dornick
characters.line: Escaped the orbital station after killing a Mule cypher; now knows the real Mule is Bayta Mallow and has to start the hunt over.

characters.name: Bayta Mallow
characters.line: Revealed as the actual Mule — the Mentalic threat has been hiding inside the Foundation's own escapee this whole time.
characters.note: Was subdued only by Magnifico's visi-sonar music.

characters.name: Toran Mallow
characters.line: Bayta's husband and fellow Foundation exile; unaware his wife is the enemy they have been running from.

characters.name: Magnifico Giganticus
characters.line: The Mule's former balladeer whose visi-sonar music is the only known thing that can hold Bayta back.

characters.name: Brother Darkness (Cleon XXIII)
characters.line: The former Dusk, now sole ruler; murdered Day, took the Prime Radiant, and believes Seldon's fall of Empire meant his own rise.

characters.name: Hari Seldon (Vault)
characters.line: Still active in the Vault; helped Gaal reach the Mule after she falsely promised him a physical body he now knows he will never get.

characters.name: Han Pritcher
characters.line: Foundation captain and Mule hunter; under Bayta's control at the finale after she used him to shoot Gaal.

characters.name: Preem Palver
characters.line: Leader of the Second Foundation, now revealed to have been hiding on Trantor itself, welcoming Kalle's book into their keeping.

characters.name: Kalle
characters.line: The mysterious woman who once gave Hari an organic body; revealed as a robot hiding on Earth's Moon and receiving the signal from Day's relic.
